scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm just checking in on the status. Could you tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or if it's still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your application has been approved and the loan was purchased by Freddie Mac. The loan product you were approved for is a Conventional:First Lien loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. I appreciate it. Can you tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs of the loan? Also, is there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.125% and the total loan costs are $3,316.75. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for providing those details. I noticed that the interest rate is a bit higher than I expected. Is there any specific reason for this rate, or is it standard for the current market conditions? Also, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it affect my application?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot provide a specific reason for the interest rate. The debt-to-income ratio is not present in the record, so I cannot provide that information.

dialogue.user: I see. Well, thank you for the information you were able to provide. I think that's all I needed to know for now. <Satisfied> The conversation was helpful and I appreciate your assistance.
